leads.title: Supreme Federal Court ruling, March 2018 - legal gender change
leads.documents: Transgender people may change legal gender without surgery or hormonal therapy, by simple application at a registry post without judicial document or medical report
leads.detail: March 2018 unanimous STF ruling; reported 59% increase in gender changes by 2024; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Manaus municipal law banning unisex restrooms, 18 October 2022
leads.documents: Bans unisex restrooms in Manaus, directly relevant to trans/non-binary visitor use of facilities
leads.detail: Signed 18 October 2022 by mayor of Manaus David Almeida; no URL visible in text

leads.title: State Law No. 7,552, 10 June 2025
leads.documents: Bans gender-affirming care for minors under age 18 in Amazonas
leads.detail: Law No. 7,552 signed into law 10 June 2025 by State Governor Wilson Lima; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Federal Public Prosecutor's Office (MPF) recommendation, August 2024
leads.documents: Recommended Amazonas formally enable outpatient and hospital services for the transsexualization process, including sexual reassignment surgeries, with deadlines for approval and presentation to Ministry of Health
leads.detail: MPF August 2024 recommendation to state of Amazonas; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Public Defender's Office of the State of Amazonas (DPE-AM) monitoring process, November 2023
leads.documents: Opened process to monitor public health services for transgender and travesti people, including provision of hormones and surgeries
leads.detail: DPE-AM November 2023 process; related to DPE-AM 2021 Sexual Diversity, Gender Identity and Citizenship Working Group (Grupo de Trabalho Diversidade Sexual, Identidade de Genero e Cidadania) on human rights violations and training of security agents; no URL visible

leads.title: Amazonas State Court of Justice (TJAM) booklet Home is a Right! / Lar e Direito!, August 2024
leads.documents: Guidance for LGBTQ youth expelled from homes; states conversion therapies are prohibited and ineffective
leads.detail: TJAM August 2024 booklet titled Home is a Right! (Portuguese: Lar e Direito!); no URL visible in text

leads.title: Nationwide criminalization of homophobia and transphobia since 2019 / Amazonas protections since 2006
leads.documents: Amazonas included sexual orientation and gender identity in state policies since 2006; homophobia and transphobia criminalized nationwide since 2019 equivalent to crime of racism
leads.detail: 2006 state policy inclusion; 2019 nationwide criminalization; no URL visible in text

leads.title: State Law No. 6,463/2023 - gender-neutral language ban in schools, and STF suspension
leads.documents: Prohibited gender-neutral language in public and private schools; challenged by ADI from National LGBTI Alliance and Abrafh; suspended by injunction from Justice Flavio Dino and confirmed by Supreme Court justices July 2024
leads.detail: Lei Estadual no 6.463/2023 proposed by state deputy Debora Menezes (PL), approved 14-4; ADI to STF; injunction 29 May by Justice Flavio Dino; July 2024 confirmation; reported struck down 27 December 2026; no URL visible

leads.title: Brazilian Public Security Forum / Brazilian Journal of Public Security data on anti-LGBTQ violence
leads.documents: Cases of violence against LGBTQ in Amazonas are underreported and have increased, with 43 cases registered
leads.detail: Research from Brazilian Journal of Public Security; data from Brazilian Public Security Forum citing 43 cases; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Killing of Fernando Vilaca de Souza, 5 July 2025 in Manaus
leads.documents: Documented fatal anti-gay incident: beaten and killed after reacting to homophobic insults in Manaus; prior bullying reported
leads.detail: 5 July 2025 Manaus; responses noted from Ministry of Human Rights and Citizenship, Order of Attorneys of Brazil and federal deputy Erika Hilton; no URL visible in text
